title: Harriet Dart Reaches Her First Big Final
summary:
British tennis player Harriet Dart has reached her first WTA Tour singles final. She beat Sun Xinran of China in three sets at the Guangzhou Open. Dart said reaching the final 'means the world' to her.

Dart is the British number five. This was only her second tour-level singles semi-final. She first played on the WTA Tour in Eastbourne in 2015. 'It's been a really long journey,' she said. 'I've wanted it so much.'

The match was like a rollercoaster. Dart lost the first set after leading 5-4. Sun, who is 16 and the US Open junior champion, took her chance. Dart won the second set in a tie-break, 7-1. In the last set, Sun needed treatment on her left leg, and Dart won every game.

On Sunday, Dart plays fourth seed Lilli Tagger in the final. Tagger is ranked 53rd. If Dart wins, she will return to the top 100. She has already climbed 14 places to 101st.
why_it_matters: It shows children that sticking with a goal for many years can pay off, even when progress is slow.
